summary: RADCOM LTD filed a Form 6-K on May 27, 2026, updating the board composition. Five directors resigned as previously reported, and three new directors were elected at an extraordinary general meeting on May 20, 2026. At a subsequent board meeting, Sami Totah was appointed Chairman, and the Audit and Compensation Committees were formed. This filing documents a significant forced/abrupt board restructuring, constituting a management change event. The filing does not involve any M&A, capital return, or other special-situation categories. No deal terms or advisor names are provided. Investors should monitor the impact of the new board on company strategy and governance.
